metric_definitions.instruction_calls: Outer ladder calls only; nested functions inside operands are opaque.
metric_definitions.branch_groups: Square-bracket branch groups outside instruction argument lists.
metric_definitions.branch_legs: Sum of the legs in all branch groups; not expanded end-to-end paths.
metric_definitions.max_branch_depth: Maximum nesting of branch groups; unbranched is zero.
metric_definitions.height_lanes: Instruction/empty sequence height 1; sequence max; branch sum of leg heights.
metric_definitions.width_instructions: Instruction width 1; sequence sum; branch max of leg widths. Wiring width excluded.
metric_definitions.expression_instruction_calls: CMP, CPT, FAL and FSC calls only; not a count of inner mathematical operations.

policies.shape_identity: Instruction labels, arity, empty argument positions, and ordered branch topology. Operand values/reuse omitted.
policies.sample_operands: Whole arguments replaced. Identical stripped argument text shares a placeholder within one sample only.
policies.opcode_labels: Explicit public list; other names become run-local UNLISTED_OP labels, not assertions of custom instructions.
policies.source_identity: Ordinal XML locators plus numeric rung Number and approved rung Type; no source filename/hash.
policies.rankings: Top distinct shapes among parsed rungs; ties use first source occurrence.
policies.limits: Structure parsing only; no instruction arity/type validation, execution graph, or import validity.
